flags.text: A blizzard! Keep the cold ones moving in.
Whoosh! Carry Pebble back to Papa.
Emperor dads keep the egg warm on their feet!
Antarctica is the coldest, windiest place on Earth.
In winter here, the sun stays away for months!
Emperor dads don't eat all winter. They just keep the egg warm!
Listen, Pebble. This is my song.
That's it! Now you'll always find me.

script.text: Carry the cold penguin into the middle!
script.when: ---- Emperor Huddle (activities/huddle/) ---- Sparkle says what to do (and a fact the first time something comes up). Papa is the only dad who talks (the others honk their own songs), Pebble in Pebble's voice. Finite: one line per moment, a few thank-yous in turn. In the last section Papa sings Pebble his song (synthesized: activities/party/sounds.ts TUNES[0], the one the finale's chick hums) and Pebble peeps it back.
